title: 第二十四 剥皮拆骨之恶，自有天道清算
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
傅烬川垂眸看她，轻轻“嗯”了一声。

    这种感觉真的很奇妙。

    他一直都不信世界上有鬼存在，

    就算是有，也不过是某种空想性错视，并不是真实存在的。

    可这几次亲眼所见后，他不得不相信有另一个世界的存在，总是会想到姜无念天天挂在嘴上的因果到底是什么。

    如果真的善有善报，

    恶有恶报，

    那为什么与人为善的父母会去世得那么早，

    自己又做错了什么？

    女鬼哭着哭着就大笑起来，凄厉的声音在房间里回荡：“我是疯子？明明你才是那个彻头彻尾的恶魔！”

    她对着姜无念，声音哽咽地哭诉着：“我们在Hot Mix认识，是他先疯狂追求我，对我温柔体贴嘘寒问暖。”

    “我以为自己终于遇到了真爱，掏心掏肺对他，可后来一切都变了，他开始沉迷赌博，欠了一屁股债。”

    “他说我去公司堵他，去大闹他的聚会？我是去求他的朋友同事劝他回头，不要再赌了，可他竟然觉得我让他丢了面子，对我拳打脚踢。”

    说着，她抬手撩起长发，脖颈上的道道淤青伤痕触目惊心，明显是长期遭受虐打才会有的痕迹。

    “他手臂上那些伤，明明是我反抗的时候不小心抓伤的。”

    “为了弄钱填赌债，他哄骗我借网贷，逼着我去卖卵，说以后会还我。那些催债的电话快把我逼疯了，他还拿着这些钱继续赌。”

    “我拿刀抵着脖子求他放过我，他拿我父母威胁我，说我死了债也要父母还！”

    “他为了讨好那些债主，让我去陪酒，债主们不松口，就骂我不够漂亮，硬把我塞进黑诊所整容……”

    “我不愿意就各种折磨我，我被折磨得精神恍惚，才被他送去做了手术，没想到……”

    “我死之后，他没有丝毫愧疚，用我的器官换了钱，拿着黑诊所的赔偿款肆意挥霍，还到处编排我是疯子，我的父母只拿到了一盒骨灰！”

    越说越激动，女鬼身上鬼气溢散，房间里的灯光不断闪烁。

    吴星河再也装不下去，从地上爬起来对着女鬼痛哭流涕：

    “我也是逼不得已啊！我错了，我给你烧很多很多钱，给你超度，保证你下辈子投胎去有钱人家，你就放过我吧！”

    女鬼嘶吼着扑上去，面目越来越狰狞，她张开血盆大口：“放过你？你这个魔鬼，我要让你血债血偿！”
content_en:
Fu Jinchuan lowered his eyes to look at her and said softly "Hmm".

    This feeling is really amazing.

    He has never believed that ghosts exist in the world.

    Even if there is, it is just some kind of fantasy illusion and does not really exist.

    But after seeing it with his own eyes these few times, he had to believe that there was another world, and he always thought about the cause and effect that Jiang Wu Nian talked about every day.

    If good deeds are truly rewarded,

    Evil will be punished,

    Then why did parents who were kind to others die so early?

    What did you do wrong?

    The female ghost burst into laughter while crying, and her sad voice echoed in the room: "Am I a madman? You are obviously the complete devil!"

    She faced Jiang Wu Nian and cried with a choked voice: "We met at Hot Mix. It was he who pursued me crazily first and was gentle and considerate to me."

    "I thought I finally met true love and loved him with all my heart. But then everything changed. He became addicted to gambling and got into a lot of debt."

    "He said that I went to the company to block him and make a big fuss at his party? I went to beg his friends and colleagues to persuade him to turn around and stop gambling, but he actually felt that I had embarrassed him and punched and kicked me."

    As she spoke, she raised her hands to lift her long hair. The bruises and scars on her neck were shocking, obviously the result of long-term abuse.

    "The wounds on his arms were obviously scratched accidentally when I resisted."

    "In order to get money to pay off his gambling debt, he coaxed me to take out an online loan and forced me to sell eggs, saying he would pay me back later. Those debt collection calls drove me crazy, and he continued to gamble with the money."

    "I put a knife to my neck and begged him to let me go. He threatened me with my parents, saying that even if I die, my parents will have to repay the debt!"

    "In order to please those creditors, he asked me to accompany him for drinks. The creditors refused to let go, so they scolded me for not being beautiful enough and forced me to be sent to a black clinic for plastic surgery..."

    "I didn't want to be tortured in all kinds of ways. I was tortured until I was in a trance, and then he sent me for surgery. I didn't expect..."

    "After I died, he didn't feel any guilt at all. He used my organs in exchange for money, squandered the compensation money from the black clinic, and went around pretending that I was a lunatic. My parents only got a box of ashes!"

    The more she talked, the more excited she became. The ghostly aura overflowed from the female ghost, and the lights in the room kept flickering.

    Wu Xinghe could no longer pretend, so he got up from the ground and cried bitterly to the female ghost:

    "I have no choice but to do it! I was wrong. I will burn a lot of money for you, give you salvation, and guarantee that you will be reincarnated into a rich family in your next life. Just let me go!"

    The female ghost screamed and rushed forward, her face became more and more ferocious, she opened her bloody mouth: "Let you go? You devil, I will make you pay with blood!"
title_en: Twenty-four: The evil of peeling off skin and bones will be punished by heaven.
